entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.5: Footwear: all kinds of footwear such as (sports) shoes, sandals, ski boots. Skates, inline skates and such can be regarded as footwear for the shoe part. Which material the footwear is made of is irrelevant. 'Leather goods' include small articles made from leather (leather suitcases and bags, gloves, wallets and belts, etc). Repair of large leather utensils (such as furniture); grinding and straightening skates and supplies of goods sold separately (laces etc.)are excluded.
